The absorption of non-heme iron can be further inhibited by dietary components such as phytates present in plant-based foods [1]. For managing iron deficiency anemia, it is recommended to integrate a variety of iron-rich foods into the diet, alongside sources of vitamin C, which can enhance iron absorption. Consulting with a registered dietitian or nutritionist can also help in creating a balanced nutritional plan tailored to individual needs [1]. Educating the public on scientifically supported nutritional advice is crucial in effectively addressing nutrient deficiencies [1].
